hints.title: Sum Modification Invariant
hints.text: Notice that type 2 queries add p to nums2[i] whenever nums1[i] == 1, increasing the total sum of nums2 by count of ones in nums1 times p.

hints.title: Maintaining nums1 Ones
hints.text: Type 1 flips bits in a range of nums1. Flipping a range [l, r] transforms the number of ones to (r - l + 1) - current_ones.

hints.title: Lazy Segment Tree Structure
hints.text: Use a segment tree over nums1 with boolean lazy flip flags to support range updates and retrieve total set bits.

hints.title: Lazy Segment Tree Query Implementation

variables: n: length of nums1 and nums2
complexity.notes: Building segment tree takes O(n); each range flip takes O(log n); sum updates and queries are O(1).
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Directly updating array ranges takes O(q * n) time.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Models range flips with a segment tree and handles nums2 additions globally.
